title: A module finite over R through a ring map R to S is finite over S
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that for a ring map R to S and an S-module M, finiteness of M over R forces finiteness over S (statement lines 717-722). The proof does not construct a smaller generating set or use finite generation of S over R: it observes that an R-generating set is automatically S-generating, because the R-structure on M is induced by the image of R in S and so the S-scalar action covers the R-scalar action on that set (proof lines 724-727). This is the restriction-of-scalars bookkeeping that the statement's two module structures hide, and the author writes it out in one sentence. H2.
